budget: Prefer managed Fabric capabilities; avoid needless data duplication or always-on low-latency compute.
security: Least privilege; separate control-plane permissions from data access; use groups/nonhuman identities where possible.
availability: No paid Fabric tenant is required for this course exercise; architecture must be defensible from source requirements.
governance: Curated executive datasets need owner, certification/endorsement plan, lineage and sensitivity/access reasoning.
on_prem: WMS_SQL is reachable only inside the private datacenter; cloud analytics must use an approved bridge/gateway/network path.
